calibration_selection: Highest calibration F1; first/lower threshold wins ties; holdout labels not used for selection
labels: Deterministic engineering transformations; independent two-reviewer adjudication pending
limitations: Not official-source or independent human-labelled evidence
Wilson intervals treat query rows as independent; shared-family correlation means they are descriptive, not institution acceptance bounds
Combined strata/source/type cells below 50 are unassessed; no broad source/category coverage claim
Thresholds are profile/dataset specific and do not prove identity; no automatic production threshold update

provider_search_latency.scope: Full provider Search only; excludes HTTP, queue, persistence and decision evaluation

Plans.Join Filter: ((n.owner_scope = d.owner) AND (n.dataset_id = d.dataset) AND (n.generation = d.generation) AND (n.fuzzy_name % screening.name_key_v1(j.name)))

Plans.Index Cond: ((owner_scope = r.owner_scope) AND (dataset_id = r.dataset_id) AND (generation = r.generation) AND (record_id = r.record_id))

evaluation_boundary: First frozen engineering holdout; scorer and projection were not tuned using holdout results. Subsequent changes bind scenario authority and runtime configuration; they do not alter this scorer/corpus.
